items.description: An AUTHORED per-seat mode family — a document-declared name plus its admitted states. player.mode <family> <state> [seat] flips a seat's published state within the family; Puck.World.Client.WorldContextFamilies context rows may then map a (family, state) pair to a binding group exactly as a built-in family does.

name.description: The family's stable name. Must not collide with a built-in family name (roster, engagement, layout) or the reserved state: prefix.

defaultState.description: The state a seat publishes before any player.mode flip — one of States.

states.description: Gets the family's admitted states. The absence-coalesce lives in the accessor for the same reason Response's does.

name.description: The state's stable name — the token player.mode <family> <state> takes and the value Client.WorldContextFamilies context rows key on.

target.description: The control application this state drives, or null for an ordinary state (the seat drives its own body normally). "camera" is the only admitted value: entering the state diverts the seat's own body intent to Idle (the existing player.control idle contract) and drives the world-authored views.flyRig from the seat's channels instead.
